content:
If you need to restore a deleted cold index, you can restore it back to the warm tier by following
the instructions in the section called “Restoring warm indexes from snapshots” and then migrating
the index back to cold tier again. You can't restore a deleted cold index directly back to the cold
tier. OpenSearch Service retains cold indexes for 14 days after they've been deleted.

hierarchy.parent: Cold storage for Amazon OpenSearch Service
